name: Fandom Wiki Redirect
description:
Simple extension to redirect from fandom wikis to the official wiki. Currently works with the following wikis:
 Terraria
 Calamity
 Thorium
 Terraria Mods
 Binding of Isaac Rebirth
 Fear and Hunger wikis
 Warframe
 minecraft
 GTA
 JoJo
 Pokémon
 League of Legends
 Overwatch
